name: files.find_file_exact
precondition: name is a non-empty string; directory (if given) exists.
postcondition: Returns the absolute path of the first file (sorted) in directory whose filename EXACTLY equals name (case-insensitive), or '' when no file matches exactly. Read-only - nothing is created or modified.
failure_mode: Returns '' when no exact match exists (an absent file is a result, never an exception); PreconditionError for an empty name or a missing directory.
returns: str: absolute path of the exact match, or '' when none.
